visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dense, dark forest at night with a single vehicle stationary, its headlights illuminating a dusty path. Large stylized orange text 'OH MY' is superimposed on the screen center. (2) Cut to the vehicle's interior where a young man with short dark hair, wearing a white tank top, looks wearily into the rearview mirror. (3) A woman with long wavy dark hair appears, wearing a pink halter top and denim shorts, initially seen through the side mirror and then walking towards the front of the car. (4) The setting shifts to a series of indoor shots in a warm, dimly lit living room with classic furniture and burning candles. The woman, now in a sparkly red dress, moves rhythmically and drinks from a wine glass. (5) A montage follows showing synchronized dancing with four other women in both the indoor room and an outdoor poolside area decorated with fairy lights and torches. (6) The man and woman interact closely; the woman touches his face as he sits shirtless by the pool. (7) A dark, ritualistic phase depicts the woman wearing a black lace veil, sitting at a table with numerous lit candles, playing with a toy car. (8) The man is shown lying on a wooden floor with blood staining his white shirt, while the woman looks into the lens with digitally enhanced red eyes. (9) The final phase shows the two characters standing together by the car in the forest as the credits roll.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A dark nocturnal forest with thick trees; a classically decorated indoor room with a chandelier, wooden walls, and a fireplace; an outdoor pool area with warm decorative string lights and tiki torches.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a dark, atmospheric synthesizer pad accompanied by the distant sound of crickets. A sharp percussive 'click' triggers a shift. (2) A mechanical 'sputter' of a car engine is briefly audible before a rhythmic electronic pop beat (110 BPM) kicks in. A breathy female voice begins singing in Mandarin. (3) A sudden 'whoosh' transition SFX accompanies a visual change. (4) The music density increases with added electronic percussion and a higher harmonic tension as the chorus arrives. (5) A sharp 'hit' SFX marks a cut to a different scene. (6) A male vocal verse enters, characterized by a lower pitch and rhythmic, rap-like delivery. (7) The song reaches a high-arousal bridge with layered synthesizers and riser effects. (8) The music suddenly cuts to a low-frequency drone as a final 'thud' SFX occurs, signaling the climax. (9) The final phase features a melodic fade-out of the BGM track with lingering synth echoes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Exposition -> Rising Action -> Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a stylized music video designed to promote the song 'OH MY' by the artist ALA. It uses cinematic tropes of forest mystery, seductive domesticity, and supernatural horror to create a memorable visual narrative that complements the electronic pop track.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video starts as a romantic encounter/seduction plot but shifts into a dark, horror-themed narrative by the end. The use of high-energy editing synchronized to the beat is characteristic of modern social-media-friendly music videos.
